readerCopy.headline: A new option can change the whole map.
readerCopy.body:
An unexpected offer may appear. A new tool makes an old process look unnecessary. A schedule changes and reveals that the arrangement only worked because nobody had tested another version. The change can also come from circumstance rather than a sudden desire for freedom. Something that used to be workable may simply stop fitting.

Jupiter conjunct Uranus makes change arrive with possibility attached. Take the surprise seriously, but do not treat it as an instruction to burn everything down. Test what the new option actually improves before making it permanent.
doNotAssume: Do not assume rebellion, quitting, relocation, technological change, or that disruption is voluntary.
